defect: The viewed-object bar hides thread features and rule settings and paints inherited values as local edits.
why_stupid: This is slop because the original thread panels, backend configuration commands and ObjectState already own those answers while the replacement bar keeps an incomplete presentation and an Override toggle.
unplanned_reason: Tristan directly reported the missing thread features and wrong inheritance editing behavior after trying the installed bar.

slop.fact: The replacement bar exposes an incomplete set instead of composing the original panel and configuration declarations.

edits: Restore the original thread features through their declared panel owners, bind them to the viewed thread and keep channels/files on their own sources.
Discover backend configuration forms including rule-gate settings through the existing command owners, sharing their editor and writer.
Show inherited values as grey previews; typing/selecting supplies a local value and Reset uses ObjectState signature defaults. Remove the Override toggle.
Use native NRA changes, one bounded original UI control and an isolated physical check; ship one coordinated install.
banned: Another handwritten setting or panel roster
Another Override flag or copied resolved-state store
Dropping existing inbound/outbound, family, context or file views
order.report: Original owners restored, native plans, focused result, physical evidence, merged source and installed boundary.

run.text: The viewed thread exposes its original panels and rule settings; inherited previews remain grey until edited, reset restores signature defaults, and selecting a channel or file never shows stale agent data.
